open_points.subject: authenticate_service_principal
open_points.text: authenticate_service_principal: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_service_credential and get_service_principal of the service_identity repository of that transaction, a ServiceIdentityRepository.
open_points.other_text: authenticate_service_principal: [BEHAVIOR] MUST read the current UTC time once per operation, by one call of utc_now, and use that single instant for every timestamp it writes and every current-time comparison it makes; it MUST NOT read a host clock itself.
open_points.question: Must the dependency note be limited to service-identity persistence reads and writes, or must the required utc_now read also go through one of the named repository operations?

open_points.subject: authorize_producer_scope
open_points.text: authorize_producer_scope: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_producer_grant of the service_identity repository of that transaction, a ServiceIdentityRepository.
open_points.other_text: authorize_producer_scope: [FORBIDDEN_ACTION] MUST NOT answer false by swallowing a failure. A principal scoped to all projects is decided by reading the project validation result's declared active field directly, without a defensive attribute lookup with a default; a principal scoped to granted projects is decided by an active, unrevoked grant for exactly this principal and project. A persistence or registry failure MUST propagate unchanged, because a scope answer of false that actually reports a failure silently denies a producer that is entitled to publish and reports it as policy.
open_points.question: Must the dependency note be restricted to service-identity persistence access, or must the required project-validation read also occur through get_producer_grant?

open_points.subject: change_service_principal_status
open_points.text: change_service_principal_status: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_service_principal of the service_identity repository of that transaction, a ServiceIdentityRepository, and through its list_service_credentials, its update_service_credential and its update_service_principal.
open_points.other_text: change_service_principal_status: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST complete its authorization check before it opens a transaction, never while one is open, because the check opens a transaction of its own and a second one nested inside this transaction is forbidden. It MUST then open its transaction with an explicit assignment, never as a context manager, reach service principal, credential and producer-grant persistence only through the service_identity repository of that transaction, append audits only with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, use no legacy transaction-level service method, and close the transaction exactly once: a successful write commits once, a failure rolls back only while the local open flag still marks the transaction open and re-raises the original failure unchanged.
open_points.question: Must audit writes use append_audit and the audit repository, or must every write use only the listed ServiceIdentityRepository operations?
